title: Mental Health Awareness and Deaddiction
summary: On the Occassion of 5th Anniversary of Agrim Agarwal Foundation, in coordination with Rotary club of addiction prevention, a workshop on Mental Health wellbeing, and deaddiction…
description:
On the Occassion of 5th Anniversary of Agrim Agarwal Foundation, in coordination with Rotary club of addiction prevention, a workshop on Mental Health wellbeing, and deaddiction among youngsters was organized on 3rd October at Nanavati Auditorium, Mumbai.
The event highlighted the growing need for families, educators, healthcare professionals and communities to engage proactively with issues affecting young people’s physical, emotional and digital well-being.
Speaking about the milestone, the Foundation’s fifth anniversary was positioned not merely as a celebration of five years, but as an opportunity to reaffirm the importance of compassion, awareness and accessible conversations around mental health and addiction.
The programme brought together multiple perspectives—from medicine and psychology to lived experiences, parenting, digital wellness and community engagement—reflecting the Foundation’s broader approach towards mental-health awareness.
